_comment: Copy to <root>\services\lotr-services\config.json (or pass --config <file>). Every key is optional; the values below are the defaults except root. Keys starting with _ are ignored.

queue._releasesDir: defaults to <root>\files\releases (the manifests tell which objects belong to role core modules)

support._secretFile: defaults to <dataDir>\secrets\support-service.secret (created at first start when missing); LOTR_SUPPORT_SECRET env var wins

siteUpdate._comment: Signed mailbox for website updates (src/site-update.js, site/docs/SITE-UPDATES.md). Own loopback listener; Caddy proxies /api/site-update to it. Disabled (404) while publicKeyFile is missing.
siteUpdate._dir: defaults to <dataDir>\site-update (inbox\, installed\, the public key)
siteUpdate._publicKeyFile: defaults to <dir>\site-update.pub.pem (copied by Install-Services.ps1 from the package keys\ folder)
